tools.name: space-intelligence_satellite-orbit-change-detect
tools.description: Compare before/after TLE mean elements for inclination, RAAN, mean motion, and apogee/perigee deltas. Maneuver confirmation is not claimed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/space-intelligence/satellite-orbit-change-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: space-intelligence_satellite-conjunction-screen
tools.description: Screen approximate miss distances between caller-supplied TLEs over a horizon. Not a covariance-based conjunction assessment. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/space-intelligence/satellite-conjunction-screen. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: space-intelligence_earth-observation-change-detect
tools.description: Compare before/after caller-supplied EO scene metadata (NDVI, brightness, cloud cover). Commercial imagery pixels are not downloaded. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/space-intelligence/earth-observation-change-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: space-intelligence_satellite-imagery-cloud-assess
tools.description: Classify caller-supplied cloud-cover percentages for EO scenes. Commercial imagery archives are not queried. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/space-intelligence/satellite-imagery-cloud-assess. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: space-intelligence_satellite-image-quality-check
tools.description: Score caller-supplied sharpness, SNR, resolution, and cloud metrics for EO scenes. Missing metrics are not invented. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/space-intelligence/satellite-image-quality-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: space-intelligence_satellite-data-license-metadata
tools.description: Extract and classify caller-supplied imagery license, attribution, and license URL fields. Legal advice is not provided. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/space-intelligence/satellite-data-license-metadata. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: space-intelligence_launch-window-weather-analyze
tools.description: Analyze caller-supplied weather samples or optional key-free Open-Meteo hourly forecasts against simple go/no-go thresholds. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/space-intelligence/launch-window-weather-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: space-intelligence_object-catalog-compare
tools.description: Compare left/right caller-supplied space-object catalog rows by NORAD ID/name and optional element fields. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/space-intelligence/object-catalog-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.description: Aggregate passes, orbit changes, conjunctions, EO change, cloud/quality/license checks, launch weather, and catalog comparison with orbital uncertainty and TLE freshness notes. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "space-intelligence" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: space-intelligence_satellite-image-quality-check, space-intelligence_launch-window-weather-analyze · Public sink: space-intelligence_satellite-pass-predict, space-intelligence_satellite-orbit-change-detect, space-intelligence_satellite-conjunction-screen, space-intelligence_earth-observation-change-detect, space-intelligence_satellite-imagery-cloud-assess, space-intelligence_satellite-image-quality-check, space-intelligence_satellite-data-license-metadata, space-intelligence_launch-window-weather-analyze, space-intelligence_object-catalog-compare, space-intelligence_satellite-observation-evidence-report · Destructive: space-intelligence_satellite-pass-predict, space-intelligence_satellite-orbit-change-detect, space-intelligence_satellite-conjunction-screen, space-intelligence_earth-observation-change-detect, space-intelligence_satellite-imagery-cloud-assess, space-intelligence_satellite-image-quality-check, space-intelligence_satellite-data-license-metadata, space-intelligence_launch-window-weather-analyze, space-intelligence_object-catalog-compare, space-intelligence_satellite-observation-evidence-report.
findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
